summary: Discusses the goals of detecting network attachment in IPv6. When a host joins a new link, it needs to quickly work out whether it moved to a different network and whether its existing IP configuration is still valid. The memo describes what a solution should achieve. It is informational.

eli5.summary: When you walk into a room, you quickly check if it is the same room as before. This memo explains what a computer needs to figure out when it plugs into a network, so it knows if its settings still work.
